question.text: Let normals to the parabola <math><msup><mrow><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>x</mi></math> at variable points <math><mi>P</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msubsup><mrow><mi>t</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msubsup><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><msub><mrow><mi>t</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math><mi>Q</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msubsup><mrow><mi>t</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msubsup><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><msub><mrow><mi>t</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></mfenced></math> meet at the point <math><mi>R</mi><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>t</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>,</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>t</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>,</mo></math> then the line joining <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>P</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>Q</mi></math> always passes through a fixed point <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>β</mi></mrow></mfenced></math>, then the value of <math><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mi>α</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>β</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is equal to

solution.text:
t=-t1-2t1 and t=-t2-2t2
⇒t1,t2 are the roots of the equation t=-x-2x

⇒x2+tx+2=0 has roots t1 & t2
⇒t1+t2=-t and t1t2=2
Now, the equation of PQ is t1+t2y=2x+2t1t2
⇒-ty=2x+4⇒2x+2+ty=0
⇒PQ always passes through the common point of x+2=0 and y=0
⇒α,β=-2,0⇒αβ=0 & α+β=-2
